attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Wisconsin state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per Wis. Stat. § 71.06: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 7.65%. Standard deductions: $13,560 Single/MFS, $25,090 MFJ/QSS, $17,790 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.
